name: Smart Translate
description: Detects source language and translates on-device with managed offline language models. Link asks before downloading missing models and lets users keep or remove downloaded languages.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.attribution: Google ML Kit Translation and Language Identification APIs

release_notes: Uses the Google Play services consent UI to install the optional Language ID module, waits for confirmed availability, and keeps explicit download/keep/remove controls for translation language models; caches LanguageIdentifier and Translator clients to reduce repeated setup and translation latency; isolates the OkHttp 3 transport required by ML Kit from Link’s OkHttp 5 host runtime.
